verdict.rationale: Bugbot findings include "Fix in Cursor" links that open the issue directly in the Cursor IDE and "Fix in Web" links that open it in Cursor's cloud agents. That is a first-party, direct handoff to a coding agent, which satisfies the story's "direct integration with Cursor" option. The handoff is locked to Cursor's own agent, and the evidence covers only these link-level claims. Missing for 10: copyable fix prompts for other agents, integration with Claude Code or Codex, in-depth documentation of the handoff flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Fix in Cursor/Web experience.
